title: Sculpt terrain height
summary: Raise, lower, smooth, flatten, or add controlled noise to terrain.
outcome: The chosen terrain changes shape without accidentally editing another patch.

sections.title: Make a sculpt stroke

steps.title: Target terrain
steps.text: Select an editable terrain patch and activate Sculpt terrain (V). Sculpting takes place in Top view.

steps.title: Choose the operation
steps.text: In the Terrain inspector choose Raise / lower, Smooth, or Flatten, then set Radius and Strength. Set Flatten height (Z) for flattening.

steps.title: Stroke and review
steps.text: Drag over the selected patch in Top view. Hold Shift while using Raise / lower to lower instead of raise. Inspect the Camera view and Undo an unwanted stroke.

tips: If no terrain changes, check that the selected patch is editable, visible, and under the Top-view brush radius.

sections.title: Refine selected vertices

steps.title: Edit a subset
steps.text: Use Vertex mode to select terrain vertices. Smooth affects the selected vertices; Flatten moves them to the specified Z height.

steps.title: Add noise
steps.text: With terrain vertices or curved-patch controls selected, choose Position, Alpha, or Position + alpha under Vertex noise. Set the amounts and click Apply noise.

tips: Noise can change shape or alpha across the selected controls; use Undo and reduce amounts if the result is too strong.
